name: skynetos
description: An overhead pixel-art motherboard that is a real control surface for every project run with Claude.
author: Goob Entertainment Co.

scripts.build: npm run verify && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run validate:board && npm run assets:bake && npm run validate:assets && npm run test

$deps: node-pty is in optionalDependencies because M3's embedded terminal will need it and nothing
imports it yet. It has no working node-gyp toolchain on this machine, so it installs unbuilt.
electron-builder.yml therefore sets npmRebuild:false — the packaged app contains zero native
modules today. M3 must flip that back and rebuild node-pty against Electron's ABI.
better-sqlite3 and keytar were REMOVED on 2026-09-09. node:sqlite in Electron 44 replaces
better-sqlite3 outright (DatabaseSync and FTS5 both verified against the real binary), and
keytar is unmaintained; M7 picks a maintained credential library then. See docs/DECISIONS.md.
